{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Inspect the full structure of duplicate patient rows
# Look at all rows where patient_id appears more than once
dup_rows = data[data['patient_id'].duplicated(keep=False)]

# Sort by patient_id and sample_seq to see the order
dup_rows_sorted = dup_rows.sort_values(['patient_id', 'sample_seq'], ascending=[True, False])

# Display the first few rows to see the pattern
dup_rows_sorted.head(20)"}
